We spend the entire year working hard and earning money, but when it comes to Taxes most of us have NO IDEA on how they work and How do we save them!
In this video we tried to explain how Income Tax actually works in India, specially in the New Regime.
We discussed the 2 Ways in the New Regime which can really help you save taxes!
Now Since the New Regime offers a limited deductions we found out some DIY Hacks for you, which you can explore to gain some tax benefits!
And the Golden Advise
Can you Avoid Taxes: NO! The IT department is much smarter than you think!
